text: Let's remember! School places: gate, library, laboratory, hall, café and rest-room.
There are twelve months in a year and seven days in a week. Their names start with a capital letter.
Ethiopia has thirteen months, and the New Year comes in September.
Practise at home: say the months and the days to your family. For more practice, visit AMBKidsJoy, and don't forget to subscribe. Goodbye!
